connector.name: 1C OData MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for 1C:Enterprise via OData with metadata and query builder tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package onec-odata-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alexgrebeshok-coder account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
